title: Takarakuzi
description: Lottery ticket system with categories - Requires EmeraldBank [ALPHA]
body:
# Takarakuzi - Lottery System

> ⚠️ **ALPHA VERSION** - This plugin is in development. Bugs may exist.

## ⚠️ Required: EmeraldBank

**[EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2) is REQUIRED!**

### Installation
1. Download [EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2)
2. Download Takarakuzi
3. Put both in plugins folder
4. Restart server

---

## Features

- **Category-based Lottery** - ore, food, function, build, other
- **Configurable Prizes** - Add/remove items via config
- **Weight System** - Control item rarity
- **Bulk Purchase** - Buy multiple tickets at once
- **Right-click to Draw** - Simple ticket usage

## How It Works

1. Buy tickets: `/kuzi <category> <amount>`
2. 10 Emeralds per ticket (from EmeraldBank)
3. Hold ticket and right-click
4. Receive random prize!

## Categories

| Category | Contents | Rare Items |
|----------|----------|------------|
| ore | Ores & minerals | Ancient Debris |
| food | Food items | Enchanted Golden Apple |
| function | Functional blocks | - |
| build | Building blocks | - |
| other | Misc items | Elytra, Totem of Undying |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/kuzi <category> <amount>` | Buy tickets |
| `/kuzi reload` | Reload config (OP) |

**Alias:** `/lottery`

### Examples
```
/kuzi ore 10    - Buy 10 ore tickets (100E)
/kuzi food 5    - Buy 5 food tickets (50E)
```

## Configuration
```yaml
prizes:
  ore:
    DIAMOND: 64
    ANCIENT_DEBRIS: 1
```

Higher weight = more common.

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `kuzi.reload` | Reload config | op |

## Requirements

- **[EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2) (REQUIRED)**
- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+

---
